Be ready for blood, sweat, and tears. You provide the sweat, your enemies — the blood and tears. Supposedly built for the beast-sized leader of an Animals pack.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Very Heavy Melee • Skill: Melee Weapon • Range: 4m/yds

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Long Handle • Mods: None

Special Features: Reduces its wielder’s DEX and MOVE by 2 (Minimum 2). If the user has BODY 15+, this weapon deals 1d6 additional damage (6d6). Victims hit by this weapon must beat a DV19 Athletics Check or else be knocked Prone. Whenever this weapon inflicts a Critical Injury, it deals 5 additional Bonus Damage (10 total) and whenever it would ablate armor, it ablates 2 additional SP (3 SP Total). Requires BODY 12+ to wield, and cannot be wielded in one hand by any means.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: 4m/yds
Pre-installed: Long Handle (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
